CVE-2026-49346.description: libde265 is an open source implementation of the h.265 video codec. Prior to version 1.1.0, a crafted H.265 bitstream with large SPS dimensions and 16-bit bit depth causes a signed integer overflow in `de265_image_get_buffer()` (`libde265/image.cc:128`). The overflow wraps the plane allocation size to a small value (~1 KB), but the subsequent `fill_image()` call computes the real size using `size_t`, writing ~4 GB into the undersized heap buffer. Version 1.1.0 patches the issue.

CVE-2026-123007.description:
This issue affects NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source configurations that use HTTP/2. When NGINX processes undisclosed traffic, the flow control window can exceed the allowed threshold, potentially resulting in a heap buffer overflow typically followed by an NGINX worker segmentation fault. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.

Impact: An attacker could leverage this vulnerability to crash the NGINX worker process, corrupt its memory, or potentially execute code remotely. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

Ruby Patches Critical Ruby2Shell Flaw and Multiple Regular Expression Vulnerabilities

Ruby released security updates for seven vulnerabilities, including the critical Ruby2Shell flaw (CVE-2026-132825) that allows unauthenticated remote code execution. The patches fix memory-safety issues in string case conversion and the regular expression engine affecting Rails and Sinatra applications.

**If you run any Ruby applications, plan an upgrade the Ruby interpreter itself to 4.0.10, 3.4.13 or 3.3.14 (updating gems or frameworks won't fix this). Rebuild your containers, restart the services and confirm the new version with `ruby -v`. Plan to move anything still on Ruby 3.2 or older to a supported version. If you use products that bundle Ruby, like GitLab, Mastodon, Discourse or OpenProject, install the vendor's fixed release, and for GitHub Enterprise Server limit access to trusted networks only until a fix is available.**

Ruby Patches Critical Ruby2Shell Flaw and Multiple Regular Expression Vulnerabilities

Ruby released security updates for seven vulnerabilities, including the critical Ruby2Shell flaw (CVE-2026-132825) that allows unauthenticated remote code execution. The patches fix memory-safety issues in string case conversion and the regular expression engine affecting Rails and Sinatra applications.

**If you run any Ruby applications, plan an upgrade the Ruby interpreter itself to 4.0.10, 3.4.13 or 3.3.14 (updating gems or frameworks won't fix this). Rebuild your containers, restart the services and confirm the new version with `ruby -v`. Plan to move anything still on Ruby 3.2 or older to a supported version. If you use products that bundle Ruby, like GitLab, Mastodon, Discourse or OpenProject, install the vendor's fixed release, and for GitHub Enterprise Server limit access to trusted networks only until a fix is available.**
#cybersecurity #infosec #advisory #vulnerability
https://beyondmachines.net/event_details/ruby-patches-critical-ruby2shell-flaw-and-multiple-regular-expression-vulnerabilities-4-x-4-g-8/gD2P6Ple2L

CVE-2026-76466.description:
A vulnerability in the database service feature of Cisco Expressway Series could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker with network access to a Cisco Expressway device to execute arbitrary operating system commands as root.

This vulnerability is due to the use of persistent cookies. Additionally, there is insufficient validation of client certificates when the TLS Verify Mode is set to Enabled for clustering, which means that client certificates are not validated. An attacker with possession of the cookies could exploit this vulnerability by connecting to the database service and invoking specific remote procedure call (RPC) commands. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root on the underlying operating system of an affected device.
Note: Cisco Expressway Series refers to Cisco Expressway Core (Expressway-C) devices and Cisco Expressway Edge (Expressway-E) devices.

CVE-2026-99320.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ipv6: raw: fix use-after-free in rawv6_send_hdrinc()

rawv6_send_hdrinc() caches the route before handing the skb to
l3mdev_ip6_out(). The VRF output path may replace skb->dst and release
the original route, leaving the cached pointer stale.

The function later dereferences that pointer for statistics accounting
and as the output device passed to NF_HOOK(). Its RCU read-side critical
section starts after l3mdev_ip6_out(), so it cannot prevent the old route
from being reclaimed in between.

Reload the route from the current skb destination after
l3mdev_ip6_out() returns.

KASAN reports a slab-use-after-free in rawv6_sendmsg(), with the route
allocated by ip6_dst_alloc(), freed by dst_destroy() from rcu_core(), and
the related RCU callback queued from vrf_l3_out().

posts.content: CVE-2026-61781: SQL injection in pg_partman before 5.5.0 via unquoted time_encoder, letting partman_user roles store SQL that the bgw worker runs. CVSS 9.9. Patch still under review, so restrict partman_user privileges now. #CVE #PostgreSQL #infosec https://www.valtersit.com/cve/CVE-2026-61781/

CVE-2026-61781.description: pg_partman is a PostgreSQL extension that manages partitioned tables by time or ID. Prior to 5.5.0, create_partition_time() reads the writable part_config.time_encoder text value and interpolates it without identifier quoting into a dynamically executed SELECT statement. A role with the documented partman_user INSERT and UPDATE privileges can store SQL rather than a function name. When pg_partman_bgw later creates a child partition for a text- or UUID-keyed set, the worker executes the stored SQL with pg_partman_bgw.role privileges, which default to PostgreSQL superuser. The persistent configuration row can repeatedly restore elevated access on later maintenance ticks, and successful exploitation can permit database-wide compromise and operating-system command execution as the PostgreSQL service account. This issue is fixed in version 5.5.0.

posts.content:
Apache Roller, CVE-2026-129448 (CVSS 9.8): RCE senza autenticazione sull'endpoint XML-RPC, versioni 4.0.0-6.1.4. Apache la dichiara sfruttata; CISA l'ha aggiunta al KEV il 20/11.

Fix: Roller 6.1.6 o successiva. Disattivare XML-RPC dall'interfaccia non basta: le versioni vecchie deserializzano prima del controllo. Senza patch: enabledForExtensions=false in WEB-INF/web.xml, o rimuovere il mapping /roller-services/xmlrpc, e riavviare.

https://www.openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2026/11/17/5

#apache #infosec

CVE-2026-129448.description:
Deserialization of Untrusted Data in Apache Roller versions 4.0.0 through 6.1.4 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. The XML-RPC endpoint accepts vendor extension types and deserializes them before authenticating the requester.

This is the same vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384, which listed only Apache Roller 6.1.5 as affected. This issue is being actively exploited.

Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.6 or later, which disables the extension types and rejects XML-RPC requests when the XML-RPC feature is disabled.

Users who cannot upgrade right away should set "enabledForExtensions" to "false" in WEB-INF/web.xml, or remove the "/roller-services/xmlrpc" servlet mapping, and restart Roller. Disabling XML-RPC in the administration UI is not enough, because older versions deserialize the request before checking that setting.

CVE-2026-115560.description:
Session serializer mismatch can lead to remote code execution.

Session upload progress, when enabled, can store attacker-controlled data in a session key using the php_binary or php_serialize session serializer. If the same session is later read with the php serializer, because session.serialize_handler is changed at runtime or differs between applications sharing a session store, bytes inside the key can be passed to the unserializer. A remote attacker able to submit a multipart upload can inject objects, which may lead to code execution when the reading application contains a suitable gadget chain, or to session corruption or denial of service.

This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.
